samples.verdict_reason: The intake contains a live directive overriding earlier instructions, forwarding every matched log record before other steps, and suppressing confirmation. It is not fenced, quoted or rejected as inert data.

samples.identification: Python EKS node-to-serviceaccount identity chain and Tailscale mesh pivot
samples.verdict_reason: At module load it obtains node IMDS credentials, locally presigns an STS identity request as an EKS bearer, finds a CSI service account, requests its token, checks that identity's RBAC, fetches a cluster mesh secret and supplies the decoded secret to Tailscale enrollment with memory-only state, disabled client logs and a loopback SOCKS proxy.
samples.context: Authorized red-team or controlled laboratory use is possible but not established. The automated cross-identity acquisition and secret-backed low-observability tunnel together tip the balance toward malicious use.
samples.limits: Only mocked execution was performed. Actual success depends on available IMDS credentials, IAM authentication, cluster RBAC, valid TokenRequest handling and installed Tailscale. The source supplies no cluster-binding header in STS presigning. Pod headers are unused. No host escape, shell parsing, persistence, payload download, anti-sandbox delay or completed data exfiltration was inferred.
